student_learning_goal: I can use a rule to predict a community outcome.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can use a rule to predict a community outcome.
header.character_watermark: Coach Cara in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Rule: 50 visitors per Saturday. Predict for 1, 4, 8, 12 weeks.
parts.visual_layout: Top of page. Four prediction rows.

image_placeholders.description: Four prediction rows in B&W, ~7in x 2.5in. Each: '___ weeks → ___ visitors'. Pre-filled weeks: 1, 4, 8, 12. Header 'Rink Predictions (50/Sat):'.

parts.student_instructions: Use 4 community rules. Predict outcomes for 1 month.
parts.visual_layout: Middle of page. Four rule rows.

image_placeholders.description: Four community-rule rows in B&W, ~7in x 3in. Pre-filled: '250 books/day x 20 days = ___', '80 pizzas/Sat x 4 = ___', '45 dogs/Sun x 4 = ___', '350 TTC/hr x 8 hrs = ___'. Header 'Community Rules (1 month):'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS03_P2_COM: keywords (community, rules) name the rows.

parts.student_instructions: Pick your own community rule. Predict for 12 weeks.
parts.visual_layout: Bottom of page. Blank rule and prediction box.

image_placeholders.description: A blank rule and prediction box in B&W, ~7in x 2.5in. 'My rule: ___'. 'For 12 weeks: ___'. Header 'My Community Rule:'.
